description: Remaining daily-loss and max-drawdown room in dollars for an account, the binding limit and breach flags, computed with the same model as the FloorGuard calculator. Same inputs as GET /api/v1/check.

accountSize.description: Nominal account size, e.g. 100000 (must be one of the program sizes when the rule is a fixed $ amount per size)

customDailyLoss.description: Your own daily loss limit in $ for programs without one (e.g. Topstep optional DLL)

dayStartBalance.description: Balance at the daily reset, if positions were held through it (default: currentEquity - todayPnl)

highWaterMark.description: Peak the firm trails from (highest EOD balance / closed balance / intraday equity, per program mode). Default: computed like the site calculator

startingBalance.description: Initial balance the percentages apply to (default: accountSize)

todayPnl.description: Today's P&L since the firm's daily reset, closed + open (default 0)

name: check_drawdown
title: Check remaining drawdown room
